react.title: React
react.importHint: `import { Box, Text, Button, Icon } from "<relative path to {kit}>"` (barrel `{kit}/index.ts`) or one module per primitive (`{kit}/box/box`).
react.example:
```tsx
<Box tag="section" className="flex flex-col gap-4 p-4 bg-card text-card-foreground">
  <Text tag="h2" className="text-foreground">Title</Text>
  <Button aria-label="Save" className="bg-primary text-primary-foreground px-4 py-2">
    <Icon size="sm"><Save /></Icon>
  </Button>
</Box>
```

webcomponent.title: Web Components
webcomponent.importHint: `import { renderBox, defineAll } from "<relative path to {kit}>/index.wc"` (`render<Part>()` or `<ui8-*>` elements after `defineAll()`).

templ.title: Go templ
templ.importHint: `import "github.com/ui8kit/codegen/generated/templ/ui/box"` (one Go package per primitive; `select` → package `selectfield`, `switch` → `formswitch`). Props are typed structs (`box.BoxProps{Tag: "section"}`); children go between `@box.Box(...) { … }`. There is no asChild: for a custom root use the exported `<Name>Classes(props)` helper (`class={ button.ButtonClasses(button.ButtonProps{}) }`).
templ.lucidePackage: inline Lucide SVG markup (copy the `<svg>` from lucide.dev; there is no official Go package)

jinja2.title: Jinja2
jinja2.importHint: `from ui8kit_jinja import environment` (put `<path to {kit}>/../jinja2` on `sys.path`), then `{% include 'ui/box/box.html.j2' %}` with `p` (canonical PascalCase props: `{'Tag': 'section', 'Class': '…'}`) and `children` (markup) in scope — one template per part (`ui/card/card-header.html.j2`). `children` is printed with `|safe`: trusted HTML only, never raw user input. There is no asChild: for a custom root use the `<name>_classes(p)` global (`class="{{ button_classes({'Variant': 'outline'}) }}"`).
jinja2.lucidePackage: inline Lucide SVG markup (copy the `<svg>` from lucide.dev; there is no official Jinja2 package)

twig.title: Twig (PHP)
twig.importHint: Composer package `generated/twig` (namespace `UI8Kit\Twig`): register `new \UI8Kit\Twig\TwigExtension()` and add `{kit}/ui` to the loader, then `{% include 'button/Button.html.twig' with { ariaLabel: 'Save', children: html } only %}` (one template per part: `<brick>/<Part>.html.twig`). Props are variables (`tag`, `class`, `ariaLabel`, `htmlFor`), extra attributes go in `attrs` (caller wins). `children` is trusted HTML printed with `|raw` — never pass user input (XSS); render it with Twig first (`{% set html %}…{% endset %}`). There is no asChild: for a custom root use `ui8kit_classes('buttonClasses', { class: 'px-4' })`.
twig.lucidePackage: inline Lucide SVG markup (copy the `<svg>` from lucide.dev) passed as `children`

latte.title: Latte (PHP)
latte.importHint: Composer package `generated/latte` (namespace `UI8Kit\Latte`): point the loader at `{kit}/ui`, then `{include 'button/Button.latte', ariaLabel: 'Save', children: $html}` (one template per part: `<brick>/<Part>.latte`, typed `{parameters}`). Props are parameters (`$tag`, `$class`, `$ariaLabel`, `$htmlFor`), extra attributes go in `$attrs` (caller wins). `$children` is trusted HTML printed with `|noescape` — never pass user input (XSS); capture Latte markup with `{capture $html}…{/capture}`. There is no asChild: for a custom root use `{\UI8Kit\Latte\Classes::buttonClasses(['class' => 'px-4'])}`.
latte.lucidePackage: inline Lucide SVG markup (copy the `<svg>` from lucide.dev) passed as `$children`
